content.name: Remarkable Athlete
entries: Thanks to your athleticism, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} rolls and Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) checks.

In addition, immediately after you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|SRD52}, you can move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|SRD52|Opportunity Attacks}.
